bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears beat the New England Patriots 30-24 in a Thursday night showdown at Soldier Field, improving to 5-2, but the win came at a cost as a devastating leg injury to star tight end Cole Kmet and rookie cornerback Malik Muhammad turned a crucial victory into a costly one . As a result, the team placed tight end Cole Kmet on Reserve/Injured , and coach Ben Johnson now says Chicago might call more plays from the jumbo formation with six offensive linemen, with backup lineman Ozzy Trapilo poised to get more playing time in those packages .

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions activated Pro Bowl safety Brian Branch and center Cade Mays ahead of their Week 7 matchup against the Green Bay Packers, with Branch making his 2026 season debut after not having played since tearing his Achilles on Dec. 4 last year.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Packers activated star running back Josh Jacobs off the Commissioner Exempt list, making him set to make his first appearance of the 2026 season after being activated to play against the Lions on Sunday , with insiders reporting he is expected to handle a normal starter's workload in his season debut despite missing Green Bay's first six games . This boost comes as Green Bay also dealt with injury concerns ahead of their Week 7 matchup in Detroit, including linebacker Zaire Franklin set to miss the game against the Lions after sustaining a shin injury in practice.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Vikings (5-0) activated running back Jordan Mason off injured reserve ahead of Sunday's Week 7 home game against the Indianapolis Colts, though the team has listed Mason as questionable for the matchup . The Mason news comes alongside other roster moves, including Jihad Ward rejoining the Vikings practice squad after a stint with the Giants , as Minnesota looks to stay unbeaten while facing a 2-4 Colts squad.
